prompt:

Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, face, expression, hairstyle, glasses, facial hair and clothing reference, Li Khiumerian. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil medium, proper feline anatomy, contained bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's face, broad jaw, shorter hair, missing glasses, serious expression or collared shirt. This is a different person.
Primary request: reimagine the man in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve his elongated fairly narrow oval face, high forehead, angular cheekbones and defined chin, dark fairly straight eyebrows with a slight thoughtful brow furrow, original eye shape and spacing behind the glasses, slightly parted relaxed lips as if speaking, and attentive friendly thoughtful expression. Preserve his distinctive BLACK full-rim rectangular glasses with gently rounded corners and clear lenses; keep the source frame shape, not round wire frames or sunglasses. Preserve the neatly trimmed medium-brown beard and connected moustache around the short muzzle, jaw and chin as darker feline fur; the beard is short and narrow, not bushy or extra broad. Natural adult proportions, no exaggerated wide-eyed cartoon face. Real short natural feline muzzle, small elegant cat nose and fine whiskers, warm muted taupe/brown fur with cream muzzle and cheek highlights.
Hair: thick medium/dark-brown hair with warm highlights, closely clipped short sides and a distinctive tall swept-UP-and-BACK voluminous quiff on top, matching image 1. Not a flat buzz cut, forward fringe or long hair.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL, on TOP of the head, both fully inside the canvas with generous clear margin above the quiff and ears. Eye-level sides of the head must be uninterrupted hair/fur: NO human ears, side ears, extra lower ears or fleshy lobes. Glasses arms disappear naturally into fur near temples without adding human ears.
Clothing: fully clothed plain dark charcoal/brown-black short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt with relaxed shoulders, matching source. Omit all chest lettering, brand emblem and logos. No collar or hoodie. Omit microphone, hands, watch and rings for the clean series-consistent upper-bust composition.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, beard, quiff and cotton, warm brown outlines and ivory highlights, matching the established character series.
Composition: square canvas, one single centered nearly frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, subtle three-quarter head angle and attentive source expression, naturally rounded lower shoulder silhouette; whole head, hair and both ears fully contained with ample transparent margins. No microphone, hands, props or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the stage, screen, illuminated letters and all background scenery. No other people, text, circle, badge, frame or watermark.
